Question B-006-005-004.

Why the correct answer is right: An open or short circuit creates a severe mismatch and can produce high SWR.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "An open or short circuit in the antenna system": Correct. An open or short circuit creates a severe mismatch and can produce high SWR.
- sourceIndex 1: "Grounding the shield of the coaxial cable at the building entrance": Coax is a shielded unbalanced feedline; it is only correct when the question is asking for that construction or practical route.
- sourceIndex 2: "Using a very long transmission line": Those choices do not normally create the severe mismatch caused by an open or short circuit.
- sourceIndex 3: "Replacing RG-213 coaxial cable with RG-58": Coax is a shielded unbalanced feedline; it is only correct when the question is asking for that construction or practical route.
